name: audit
description: Ecosystem documentation audit: banned words, dead links, and missing anchors across READMEs, wiki, docs, SPORT, PPI, and PRI.
author: nself
notes: This is a CLI-proxy plugin, not a service plugin: it has no port, no HTTP server, and no database tables. `nself plugin install audit` must place the built nself-audit binary at ~/.nself/plugins/bin/nself-audit, where internal/plugin/router.go's ProxyCommand execs it for `nself audit <args>` with stdio inherited. Extracted from cli/cmd/commands/audit.go and the docs-audit files of cli/internal/audit/ under CLI-R11; internal/audit/table_audit.go and event_log.go stayed in core (shared with `nself plugin audit-tables` and the security event log respectively).
